## Pre-launch Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md] and opened this PR against the branch it asks for.
- [ ] I listed at least one issue this PR fixes, or the change is trivial.
- [ ] I added or updated `///` docs for every public API I changed.
- [ ] I added tests for the change, or explained above why it can't be tested.
- [ ] I added a line under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md for anything users will notice, starting with `Breaking:` for breaking changes.
- [ ] `dart format .`, `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass locally.

**Note**: pull requests get an automated review from [CodeRabbit](https://docs.coderabbit.ai). Its comments are suggestions, not requirements. If you disagree with one or aren't sure, leave it and wait for a review from the maintainer.
